scope: One registered multi-event physical subdomain; finite-grid autodiff sensitivity versus independent refined FV-PDE centered differences; not global continuum-gradient proof
initial: center active atom, normalized coordinate zero
outputs: Three relative-threshold CDFs after projecting active mass uniformly into its Voronoi bins, lower/upper refractory mass, full repeated-event expectation; separately three exact finite-node strict-bank-complement CDFs (<= threshold)
cdf_reference: Projected FV-PDE CDF at relative physical thresholds k*b. The strict finite-node outputs are compared against this continuous-density approximation and retain their atom bias
reference_independence: Archived independently implemented NumPy central-difference generator with truncated Gaussian reset and scipy.sparse.linalg.expm_multiply; no torch kernel called for reference construction or centered differences
cost: Retain every PDE call full terminal mass, physical point, observable vector, wall and process CPU; report total cost separately
publication: Publish this source/protocol before execution, record full source commit and exact source snapshots; verify frozen kernel and reference hashes before/after
failure_retention: Exclusive attempt files preserve every check/exception and source snapshot, no failed case deletion or new threshold tuning
limits: Physical derivatives hold other physical parameters fixed, normalized initial coordinate and relative thresholds fixed. Bounds/scale gauge remain; this is one local sensitivity comparison, not arbitrary moving-boundary, arbitrary recovery, whole-domain accuracy or task benefit
